tei:div.tei:p: (ta)༄༅// gsang ba bstan pa'i snang byed mchog gi sprul sku ngag dbang phrin las dpal bzang bar brda sprod kun bshad kyi mtshan gsol bi rta bzhugs so// ༄༅// wāgīshwaraḥkumārabikrīḍitamāyāsāraswatīṣaḍas+yahar+ṣokathikāho/ sūk+taṃkṛtiḥtsamūdishebh+yobidzayas+yaswastes+sadābidhirdzinais+sādhayasar+b+baiḥ/

༄༅// ngagaṃ dbang gzhonaṃ nu'i sgyuṃ 'phruṃl rnaṃm paṃr rtsenaṃ// dbyaṃngs ldaṃn gdoṃng druṃg dgyeṃs pa'i ngo mtshar gtam// smraṃ mkhaṃs phyogaṃs laṃs rnaṃm paṃr rgyaṃl baṃ'i sdeṃr// rtag par shis pa'i cho ga rgyal kun sgrubs// ༄༅// itiwāgīshwarakar+m+mashrībhadrikas+yapādāts+tshīghanasar+b+beṣā+eguṇodadhiṃpraṇidh+yād+bhūtaparbatenaman+thitadzāto/ t+tāmanir+m+mākāyas+yashubh+raṃshukumāraḥ kalāpabyākaraṇas+yagran+thaṃgais+sahāṇāṃshrutam+bi ༄༅// zhes dpal stug rnams kyi yon tan chu gter smon lam rmad byung ri bos bsrubs skyes// mchog gi sprul sku'i zla gzhon ngag dbang phrin las dpal bzang pa'i zhal snga nas// cha bsags brda sprod pa'i gzhung yan lag tu bcas pa'i tsāraṇānāṃkhaṇ+ḍapūritot+pāditas+yashubhanāmaṃ/ wāgīshwarakumāras+yamāyābikrīḍitaswaraswatīṣaṇ+mukhaunan+danas+yok+tam+baṭudig+bh+yobidzayas+yasenonām/ pañtsabid+bhānakānāṃshrīkaṇ+ṭhashirasamabhiṣe gsan dpyod kyi cha shas rdzogs par bskrun pa'i dge mtshan du/ ngag dbang gzhon nu'i sgyu 'phrul rnam par rtsen pa/ dbyangs ldan gdong drug dgyes pa'i smra mkhas phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i sde zhes/ lnga rig smra ba'i dpal mgrin ral par koyadā/ bihāraṃsh+shutibhiḥshap+dagraho3bhagahīnaṃbhūtas+yaban+deshīlarat+naṃnāma.āhwen/ tsalarīnādīkāñtsanasaṃyuk+tāyāḥpratīraṃmunish+shāsanodhar+m+matsakradwīpelikhitaṃswastibidzayatu/ sarbadharmāḥsaṃkhyanāmaugīsh+tsāk+ṣaratsitradhimaṃ/ matibhāsaṃwar+dhanedamash+tsar+yamādar+shagaṇ+ḍa/ mnga' gsol ba gang tshe/ gtsug lag thos pa rnams kyis sgra 'dzin skal ba mi dman par gyur pa'i btsun pa tshul khrims rin chen zhes bod pas/ 'bri klung gser ldan ma'i 'gram ngogs thub bstan chos 'khor gling du bris pa dge legs rnam par rgyal bar gyur cig /zhes 'di yig rtsis bsgyur bgod kyi// ri mo'i gzugs snang 'char ba'i gzhi// chos kun grangs dang ming tshig gi /yi ger bkra bas blo ldan gyi// blo gros snang ba 'phel byed 'di// ngo mtshar gaṇ+ḍa'i me long yin// gaṇ+ḍa'i ming 'dogs don gnyer ngor// shī la rat+nas sug bris dge

/thugs rje che myur pad+ma ka ra yi// zhal lung nyi zer thos bsam bsgom stobs kyis// lung rtogs yon tan chu skyes 'dab ma brgya// kun nas rnam grol 'dren pa mchog la 'dud// grub dbang pad+ma'i gdung 'tshob khyod kyis mngon// 'gro kun yongs su ma grol de srid du// chos dang sems can phan 'dogs dam bcas ltar// srid par skye ba'i sgyu 'phrul ston cig kye// rgyal med sras sku gdod ma'i smon lam mthus// gang la gang 'dul de de'i skur ston na// brtse dang byang chub sems ldan khyod kyis kyang*// 'gro 'dul sprul skur mi ston ci ste bzhugs// snying rje'i rang gzugs de yang dal 'byor rten// bla ma lha yis rjes bzung phyi nang gi /shes bya'i gzhung brgyad rnam par dpyod pa'i blo// ma zlum dkyil 'khor lhar gsal skye ba ston// skyabs gsum bslu ba med pa'i shing rta che// bdag cag gsol btab rkang mgyogs kha lo pas// dam pa'i yang srid nor bu legs drangs nas// ji snyed gdul bya'i re ba 'gengs par shog /ces mkhas btsun grub pa'i 'dren mchog pad+ma kun grol zhing khams gshegs tshe/ sprul sku myur 'byon gyi gsol 'debs smon lam rkang mgyogs grub pa'i pho nya zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rdzogs chen sprul pa'i sku mchog rnam gnyis gsung gis bskul ba'i ngor/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas ru dam chu tshan khar bris pa sarba kā mar+tha sid+dhaṃ bha wa tu// ༈ //so thar byang sems rig 'dzin sngags sdom rnams// legs bzung rgyal ba phrin las rgyun mi chad// skyong ba'i dbang phyug aṃ tiṃ yo gas mtshon// bstanaṃ pa'iṃ rgyalaṃ mtshaṃn bslang ba zhabs brtan gsol// bla ma 'chi med mgon sogs tshe sbyin lha// kun gyis 'gro la rjes chags sprul pa'i sku// bskal pa'i bar du tshe la dbang ba sogs// dbang bcu grub pa'i byin rlabs dngos grub stsol// thams cad mkhyen pa'i go sar 'jug pa'i sgo// bzo gso sgra tshad rig pa yan lag bcas// sde snod rgyud sde'i dgongs don mkhyen pa'i rab// 'jam dpal snying dbus zhugs sam nyid du gyur// brtun pa rmad byung tshe gcig sangs rgyas par// 'khrid byed gsang sngags gsar rnying bstan pa'i gsal// yongs bzung 'chad rtsom brtsad pa'i phrin las kyis// srid pa'i pha rol nyul ba yin snyam gyur// bla ma'i byin rlabs yi dam thugs rje dang*// bstan srung mthu rtsal bdag gi lhag bsam mthus// ji ltar 'dod gsol smon pa'i lam de kun// gegs bral snye ma g.yur du za bar shog

/ces 'dren mchog rdzogs chen sprul pa'i sku mchog rig 'dzin phrin las dbang phyug a ti bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan par zhabs brtan smon gsol dbang bcu grub pa'i bcud len zhes bya ba 'di ni grub dbang kun bzang pa'i gsung gis bskul ngor/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas ru dam chu tshan khar bris pa sarbār+tha sid+dhaṃ bha wa tu// ༈ //nam mkha'i mtha' klas 'od gsal bde ba ches// rang snang ma 'gags sprul pa'i zlos gar gyis// gsang chen sngags kyi bstan pa 'dzin skyong gi /khur chen bzhes pa rgyal ba'i sras la 'dud// smon lam dgyes dgongs legs byon sprul sku dang*// chu gter bsrubs skyes zla ba kun gyi gtsug /mdzes par mtshungs kyang brtse dang byang sems kyis// dben phyir dgung zlas mchod la bsgrun du med// so thar sdom pa'i skyon bral pad+ma dkar// rgyal sras spyod pa'i ge sar bye bas mdzes// sngags spyod grub pa'i lte bar ches mtho ba// gdul bya bung ba'i dpyid dud brtan bzhugs shig /zab gsang sngags kyi lta sgom spyod pa la// 'dris pa'i gom stabs grub pa'i sar bsgyur zhing*// rgyal ba sras bcas bstan pa'i phrin las rgyun// yongs 'dzin smra ba'i mchog tu rtag brtan gsol// de ltar gsol btab dge bas dad sgrol che// gang gi sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba gsum// rin chen lhun po lam gsum rgyun 'bab dang*// legs bris lam gyi spun zlar brtan gyur cig /ces mchog gi sprul sku gsang sngags bstan 'dzin par/ zhabs brtan smon lam dad ldan mgul rgyan zhes bya ba 'di ni/ grub dbang bla ma kun bzang pa'i gsung gis bskul ngor/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas ru dam chu tshan khar bris pa sarbār+tha sid+dhaṃ bha wa tu// ༈ //rgyal kun phrin las rang gzugs karma pa'i// bstan pa'i 'dab stong bzhad pa'i nyin mor byed// phyi nang gtsug lag chos kyi snang ba che// lnga rig bstan pa'i sgron mar gsol ba 'debs// sangs rgyas yon tan bsam mi khyab bdag kyang*// las nyon sgrib pa'i gdul byas mthong dka' bas// mkhas btsun bzang po'i gar gyi gdul bya rnams// byang chub 'dren pa rgyal sras spyod pa'i lugs// 'gro 'dul chos kyi 'byung gnas zab zhi'i dbyings// brtul ba'i bde stong mchog gi ror spyod kyang*// byang chub spyod pa'i smon lam gang 'dul sku// ston pa'i dbyar dam nyams na mi rung dgongs// rang gi gdul skal gyur pa'i sems can ngor// tshad med snying rje'i shing rta la bcibs te// mchog gi sprul sku'i ma zlum la gor nyid// skye ba'i khyim du zlos gar rtsen cig gu// gang phyir dal 'byor skye ba'i legs bris dbang*// 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i spyan stong rnam bkra bas// spyi dang bye brag ring lugs mtho ris kyi// rgyal srid skyong ba'i byed po da tshur spyon// snying rje'i gzhan don goms pa rnams kyi thugs// rang don bde la mi chags gang gi phyir// mgon med gdung ba'i ngud mo'i 'bod pa la// mchog sprul mi 'byon bzhugs pa bzod lags grang*// skyabs gsum bka' lung bden pas bslu ba dang*// sprul sku myur 'byon gsol btab rgyu 'bras kyis// bslu ba chos la mi srid bden pa des// bdag sogs re ba bskang ba'i rgyur gyur cig

/ces karma bstan pa'i nyin byed gtsug lag chos kyi snang ba zhes grags pa gzugs sku chos dbyings su brtul yang*/ sprul sku myur 'byon gyi rgyud bskul dbang gi lcags kyu zhes bya ba 'di'ang sku dbon dam pa'i gsung bskul phebs 'phral tshul rin gyis gus pas sbyar ba sarbār+tha sid+dhaṃ bha wa tu// // ༄༅// thub pa gnas brtan 'khor tshogs bcas la yan lag bdun pa 'bul ba dang dgos skabs kyi 'dod gsol don gnyis 'grub pa'i pho nya zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsang gsum yon tan dang*// stobs sogs che ba mtha' dag 'phrin shod pa'i// smra mkhas sa gsum khongs na dkon pa'i phyir// ston mchog rang nyid dper bstan shākya'i tog /thub dbang ye shes sgyu 'phrul nyan thos tshul// bcu drug zlos pas bstan pa nam gnas bar// 'dzin skyong spel ba'i thugs rje gzhal btub na// stong gsum srang du bcal ba'i do zla min// gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rgyal ba'i sras// dgra bcom 'khor tshogs zham ring bka' srung bcas// mkhyen brtse nus pas bstan pa dar ba dang*// lus can phan bde 'byung gnas rin po che// de dag kun gyi yon tan brgya stong cha// yid la byas pa'i dad gsum khur lci bas// sprul pa'i lus brgya ngal ba'i yan lag lnga// sa la yang yang ngal gso spyod snyam bgyi// dngos dang yid kyi mdzod stong phye ba las// yon chab khrus rdzing me tog bdug pa'i sprin// mar me byug pa zhal zas bstod dbyangs kyi// sil snyan nam mkha'i mtha' la co 'dri mkhan// mthol zhing bshags so sngon nas da lta'i bar// 'dod khro gti mug sems kyis kun bslangs pa'i// sgo gsum sdig sgrib nyes ltung gang lags pa// 'gyod dang sdom sems dag pa'i nges shes kyis// nyin mtshan mgon po zung 'od spros pa las// nyi dga' zla dga'i 'dab stong bzhad byed na// 'khor 'das 'gro ba'i dge tshogs bsags dgu la// yi rang 'dzum brgya dmul bas cis mi spel// mtshan bzang gzugs sku rnam kun mchog ldan dbyings// brtul la phyogs rnams dgongs pa mi 'gegs mod// 'khor ba ma stongs de srid sems can don// mdzad pa'i smon lam g.yar dam dran pa bskul// smra mchog 'dzum sgros ut+pal khongs gseng las// tshangs dbyangs rkang drug myos pa'i glur 'jo bas// theg gsum sbrang rtsi'i dga' ston rgyun mi chad/

lus can thar pa'i gsos su stsal du gsol// dge ba 'di yis zab dang rgya che'i tshogs// dpag yas rab rdzogs rang dang gzhan gyi don// 'bad rtsol med pa lhun grub shes bya'i yul// thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob phyir bsngo// 'dis mtshon dge bas bdag gzhan skye ba kun// mi khom brgyad du skye ba'i sgo bsdams nas// dal brgyad 'byor bcu ldan pa'i lus bskrun par// dge bcu'i bag chags sad pa'i rigs su sbyor// phyi nang shes bya 'doms pa'i bshes gnyen gyis// dkon mchog gsum po 'bral med skyabs su bcings// tshul khrims gsum sogs bslab pa'i gzhi kun la// mig ltar gces par bsrung bar byin gyis rlobs// bzo gso sgra dang tshad ma yan lag bcas// sde snod rgyud sde'i gzhung don 'grel ba'i blo// 'jam dpal dbyangs can snying dbus su bzhugs nas// dpyad gsum bgro gleng byed 'drar byin gyis rlobs// bcu phrag shes bya'i rgyud las 'phos pa'i mchid// 'chad rtsom brtsad pa'i dbyangs snyan 'bum 'jo bas// blo ldan kun gyi snying gi brtan pa dag /rang dbang 'phrog pa'i byed por byin gyis rlobs// ma bris tshogs sbyor mthong sgom byang grol dang*// yon tan yi ge ma bkrus dag pa'i rgyud// rnam gsal gom pa'i stabs 'ga' ma bsgyur bar// sa lam rim bgrod nus par nyid byin rlobs// rno mtshon thogs dang khro gnyer ma bsdus par// bdud bzhi'i dpung las rnam rgyal gsang ba gsum// yon tan mi zad thob pa 'di ci zhes// bsnyengs bral dbyangs la bsgrun pa'i zla bral shog /bkra shis g.yas su 'khyil ba'i dpal mgur las// skye lnga'i sgra dbyangs brgyad khri'i chos phung gi /khor yug bde ster lhar bcas skye dgu la// sngon med chos kyi snang chen spro bar shog /ces pa'i rjes su bdag gzhan dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di yis ni// zhes sogs man chad dkyus ltar brjod do// zhes thub pa gnas brtan 'khor tshogs bcas la yan lag bdun pa 'bul ba dang*/

dgos skabs kyi 'dod gsol don gnyis 'grub pa'i pho nya zhes bya ba 'di ni/ gnas brtan bcu drug gi bstod gsol skabs su sbrel te 'don pa'am/ 'di kho na zur du 'don byar rung ba slob bu shākya chos 'phel gyis bskul ngor/ ngag dbang tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas lhun grub steng gi chos grwar bris pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/ ༈ //rgyal ba'i zhal lung kun dga'i 'byung gnas la// thos bsam bsgoms pas legs sbyangs blo gros kyis// mdo sngags chos tshul 'doms pas gdul bya'i khams// bsod nams ye shes tshogs rab spel la 'dud// chos 'dul bslab pa la gnas rgyal sras lam// gsang chen lta sgom spyod kun dga' ba khyod// dpag bsam rtsa ba rab brtan yal 'dab dang*// snye mas dud bzhin mdzes par zhabs brtan shog /de ltar bstod pa'i bsod nams rgya mtsho'i sprin// gus ldan bla mar dkrigs las phan bde'i char// rtag par 'jo bas gnas skabs mthar thug gi /bsam don lo legs 'grub par nyid byin rlobs// ces chos rje kun dga' bsod nams pa la bsngags pa phan bde'i char 'jo zhes bya ba 'di'ang slob bu dpal ldan rgyal mtshan gyi ngor/ ngag dbang tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa dge bar gyur cig/ ༈ //bskal bzang sems dpa' stong las thugs bskyed stsal// rmad byung dus 'dir 'tshang rgya mngon bgyis nas// legs gsungs snang bas khams gsum gzhi lo dang*// 'bras bu'i bde sbyor thub pa'i dbang por 'dud// gang gi dpal mgur skye ba lnga pa'i sgras// sgra gcan 'dzin sogs chags bral zug pa'i dgra// nges par bcom pa'i blo mchog khyed cag rnams// rga shi med pa'i go sar gzhes nas kyang*// nga yi lung rtogs bstan pa sems can khams// phan pa'i phrin las can 'di lnga brgya phrag /mang por gnas pa'i 'dzin skyong spel cig ces// rgyal tshab bkod pa'i thos sgrogs 'di dag ste// gang phyir ston pa gnas brtan bcu drug dang*// zhom ring dharma ta la las bzang gi

/ha shang ston pa'i bstan pa srung ba la// mthu chen thob pa rgyal chen rnam bzhi bcas// sku brnyan brgya byin tshon ris gsar pa dang*// mtshungs las byin rlabs thugs rje phan yon gyis// khyad par gyur 'dir ngag dbang pad+ma yis// rgyu sbyor bkod pa phun sum tshogs pas bzhengs// dge bas sbyin pa'i bdag dang ltos 'khor dang*// gson gshin 'brel thogs 'gro rnams byang chub bar// dal 'byor rten thob bslab gsum rnam dag ldan// sangs rgyas bstan pa'i phrin las skyong gyur cig /yul gru 'dis mtshon yangs pa'i 'jig rten gyi// lus can mtha' dag nad med bde 'byor ldan// dge bcur spyod cing dkon mchog gsum tshogs dang*// 'bral med skyabs su thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig /skyabs gsum mchod cing bstod pa'i rten 'brel dang*// rang nyid brtse dang byang sems bsgoms pa'i mthus// tshogs gsum bstar ba'i lam du gang song ba// thams cad gegs med 'grub pa'i shis pas skyongs// ces drel dkar bla ma ngag dbang pad+mas thub pa gnas brtan 'khor bcas kyi sku brnyan bzhengs pa'i bsngo byang tshogs zung chu gter 'phel ba'i zla ba zhes bya ba 'di'ang*/ ngag dbang tshul khrims rin chen zhes bod pas bris pa sarba ka l+yā ṇa bha wa tu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
